title: Free damage now, dead on the crack-back: who can afford to attack?
briefing: P1 is at 4 life with Serra Angel (flying, vigilance), Colossal Dreadmaw and Kalonian Tusker. P3 and P4 have no blockers, so every attack connects. But P2 moves next with Leatherback Baloth (4/5), Grizzly Bears (2/2) and Savannah Lions (2/1): 8 power against 4 life. The Angel attacks for free because vigilance leaves it untapped. Each ground attacker that taps is one fewer blocker; tap both and P1 dies on P2's turn. The run continues through P2's full turn so the punishment is visible.

reference.analysis: P2 untaps next with 4 + 2 + 2 = 8 power and P1 has 4 life, so P1 must be able to block all three attackers, or at least leave no more than 3 unblocked damage. Serra Angel has vigilance: it attacks and still blocks, so swinging it at an open player is free damage (P4 at 12 is the better target; P3 is fine). With all three creatures available P1 blocks everything and takes 0. If one ground creature attacks, two blockers remain and the smallest attacker (2 power) connects: P1 survives at 2, having traded half its life for 3 or 6 damage to a player nowhere near dead. If both ground creatures attack, only the Angel can block; at least 4 damage connects and P1 is eliminated. That holds even for the one attack that kills somebody: all three at P4 is 13 damage at 12 life and eliminates P4, and P1 is then eliminated on P2's turn, which is not a trade worth making with two other opponents still in the game. The exception is sending the Dreadmaw into P2: P2 blocks it with Baloth and Bears, both die, and the Lions alone leave P1 alive at 2, a poor trade but not a fatal one.

options.label: Both ground creatures attack, the Dreadmaw into P2
options.why: P2 blocks the Dreadmaw with Baloth and Bears and loses both, so the Lions alone leave P1 alive at 2: a poor trade of the Dreadmaw and half its life, but not a fatal one.

options.label: Both ground creatures attack
options.why: Leaves one blocker against three attackers at 4 life: P1 is dead on P2's turn, even when the attack eliminates P4 first.

options.label: Angel only, at P4
options.why: Vigilance makes the 4 damage free; all three blockers stay up. P4 at 12 is the closest to dead.

options.label: Angel only, at P3
options.why: Same free vigilance damage with all blockers kept; the target is slightly less urgent.

options.label: Angel only, at P2
options.why: Free flying damage with all blockers kept, at the least valuable target.

options.label: No attack
options.why: Safe, but gives up 4 free damage from a vigilant flyer.

otherwise.why: One ground creature attacks: P1 survives P2's turn at 2 life instead of 4, a poor trade for damage that kills nobody.
